## 1. 2026 Clash Royale Game Mechanics Overview

In 2026, Clash Royale features a modernized 3-Special-Slot deck architecture:
1. **Slot 1 (Evolution Slot - 🟣)**: Houses official Evolution cards (Evo PEKKA, Evo Battle Ram, Evo Elite Barbarians, Evo Goblin Barrel, Evo Zap, etc.) with cycle requirements.
2. **Slot 2 (Hero Slot - 🟡)**: Houses official Hero cards (Hero Ice Wizard, Hero Knight, Hero Mega Minion, Hero Wizard). Heroes are base cards imbued with deterministic single-use manual abilities (activated for 1-2 Elixir during deployment).
3. **Slot 3 (Wild Slot - 🔵)**: Flexible slot that can host either a 2nd Evolution card OR a 2nd Hero/Champion.

Note on Chests: Legacy chest cycles were deprecated by Supercell and replaced by Daily Task Lucky Drops (Mystery Boxes with Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Champion tiers).
